description: Source code for serial communication and system frequency configuration for the AR71XX hardware platform, including UART initialization, data transmission, and frequency calculation functions.

methods.name: ar71xx_sys_frequency
methods.description: Calculates CPU, DDR, and AHB frequencies based on PLL register values for AR71XX hardware.

methods.name: serial_init
methods.description: Initializes UART serial communication with specified baud rate.

methods.name: serial_tstc
methods.description: Checks if data is available to read from UART.

methods.name: serial_getc
methods.description: Reads a character from UART input buffer.

methods.name: serial_putc
methods.description: Outputs a character via UART, converting newline to carriage return + newline.

methods.name: serial_setbrg
methods.description: Stub function for setting baud rate generator, currently empty.
